# Microsoft WebView2 Loader

Official NuGet package: Microsoft.Web.WebView2 **1.0.3650.58**.

Source: https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/microsoft.web.webview2/1.0.3650.58/microsoft.web.webview2.1.0.3650.58.nupkg

Included file: `build/native/x64/WebView2Loader.dll`.
SHA-256: `8427b1fc58ec707813e5c0a51eb5d69397bb333250a7b891be4d3b123f1e0f1c`.

The original Microsoft license is in `LICENSE.txt`. The loader is embedded in the executable and extracted into a fresh private folder for each launch. The installed Evergreen WebView2 Runtime supplies the browser engine.
